nodes.summary: Let $\mu$ be a probability measure on $\mathbb{R}$ with characteristic function $\varphi(t) = \int e^{itx} \, d\mu(x)$, and let $l \ne 0$ be real. Then $\varphi(l) = 1$ if and only if $\mu$ gives mass $1$ to the lattice $\{(2\pi / l) k : k \in \mathbb{Z}\}$.
nodes.title: A characteristic function equal to one detects lattice support

nodes.summary: Let $\mu$ be a probability measure on $\mathbb{R}$ that is a lattice random variable. Then there is a real number $h \ne 0$ such that $\mu$ gives mass $1$ to the lattice $\{hk : k \in \mathbb{Z}\}$.
nodes.title: Lattice random variables are supported on a lattice

nodes.summary: A measure $\mu$ on $\mathbb{R}$ with characteristic function $\varphi(t) = \int e^{itx} \, d\mu(x)$ is a lattice random variable if $\varphi(l) = 1$ for some real $l \ne 0$ and $\varphi(t) \ne 1$ for some real $t$.
nodes.title: Lattice random variable
